    return G
G=load()

def detect(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]); cc=[]
    for r in range(1,H-1):
        for c in range(1,W-1):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            nzs=[g[x][y] for x,y in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]]
            if any(x==0 for x in nzs): continue
            nb=set(nzs)
            if len(nb)==1 and next(iter(nb))!=v: cc.append((r,c,v))
    return cc

def f(g):
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cc=detect(g)
    for r,c,v in cc:
        # vertical up/down
        k=r-1
        while k>=0 and out[k][c]==0: out[k][c]=v; k-=1
        k=r+1
